plotEn:
Vidyarmo, the leader of a small-town gang, is released from prison and plans a major robbery based on information he acquired while incarcerated. He teams up with his nephew Ousep and former rival gang leader Darly Marty to steal a share of the proceeds from a gold biscuit heist. However, they faces revenge from a ruthless gang led by Yoyaki.
The film is set in a coastal village. The first half progresses by showing the relationships and clashes between the local gangsters in the village. There are scenes of bloody violence in the second half.
